dialogues.jp: 「暖かくなってきたな……」
dialogues.en: "It's warm..."
dialogues.text: "It's warm..."

dialogues.jp:
真っ青な空を見上げる。日差しは目を射るよう
で、空気もぬるい。
dialogues.en:
The air was tepid, as I looked up to the blue sky, the sun's
rays shooting into my eyes.
dialogues.text:
The air was tepid, as I looked up to the blue sky, the sun's
rays shooting into my eyes.

dialogues.jp:
「これくらいなら、中庭でメシを食っても寒さ
　に震える事はないな。２月中は結構きつかっ
　たから……」
dialogues.en:
"Now that eating in the courtyard is no longer cold, that
means Feburary is definitely over..."
dialogues.text:
"Now that eating in the courtyard is no longer cold, that
means Feburary is definitely over..."

dialogues.jp:
そもそも、何で寒いのを我慢してまで中庭に出
るのかは、自分でも分からなかったのだが。
dialogues.en:
Then again, there's no real reason not to eat here even when
it is cold...
dialogues.text:
Then again, there's no real reason not to eat here even when
it is cold...

dialogues.jp:
「ま、俺の存在意義を揺るがしかねない思索は、
　止めにしておくか……」
dialogues.en:
"Maybe coldness would prevent me from keeping my mind on
pondering my existence in this shallow world?"
dialogues.text:
"Maybe coldness would prevent me from keeping my mind on
pondering my existence in this shallow world?"

dialogues.jp: ぶつぶつと呟きながら、パンを口に運ぶ。
dialogues.en: I muttered to myself as I took a bite out of my bread.
dialogues.text: I muttered to myself as I took a bite out of my bread.

dialogues.jp: と。
dialogues.en: Then.
dialogues.text: Then.

dialogues.jp:
俺の座っているベンチに、腰掛ける男子学生が
いた。
dialogues.en: A male student sat on the bench I was sitting on.
dialogues.text: A male student sat on the bench I was sitting on.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「知ってるか？　朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Have you heard, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Have you heard, Asakura?"

dialogues.jp: 杉並だった。
dialogues.en: It's Suginami.
dialogues.text: It's Suginami.

dialogues.jp: 「知らん」
dialogues.en: "Nope."
dialogues.text: "Nope."

dialogues.jp: パンを頬ばる。
dialogues.en: I continue chewing on my bread.
dialogues.text: I continue chewing on my bread.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「…………そこは一応、なんだ？　と聞くくら
　いしてもらわないと、話が先に進まないだろ
　う」
dialogues.en:
"......You sure you don't want to know? It's rather
interesting, methinks."
dialogues.text:
"......You sure you don't want to know? It's rather
interesting, methinks."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そう言って欲しいのなら、最初からそう言え」
dialogues.en: "If you want to tell me, then start from the beginning."
dialogues.text: "If you want to tell me, then start from the beginning."

dialogues.jp: 俺はため息を吐き出して。
dialogues.en: I sighed heavily.
dialogues.text: I sighed heavily.

dialogues.en: "...So what is it?"
dialogues.text: "...So what is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「うむ、実はな……」
dialogues.en: "Mm, it's about..."
dialogues.text: "Mm, it's about..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ことりがまた早退したんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Kotori leaving school early today."
dialogues.text: "Kotori leaving school early today."

dialogues.jp:
そう言ったのは、俺を挟んで杉並と反対の場所
に腰掛けた工藤だった。
dialogues.en: Kudou chipped in, sitting next to Suginami.
dialogues.text: Kudou chipped in, sitting next to Suginami.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「むぅ。俺の台詞が奪われてしまった……」
dialogues.en: "Muh, my line has been appropriated..."
dialogues.text: "Muh, my line has been appropriated..."

dialogues.jp:
わけのわからないことで頭を抱える杉並は無視
することにした。
dialogues.en:
Ignoring the head-holding Suginami, I question Kudou
further.
dialogues.text:
Ignoring the head-holding Suginami, I question Kudou
further.

dialogues.jp: 「ことりが？」
dialogues.en: "Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "Kotori?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「今、またって言ったよな？」
dialogues.en: "Did she say anything about it?"
dialogues.text: "Did she say anything about it?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「前にことりと同じクラスだったって奴から聞
　いたんだけど、頭痛で早退するのって、しょっ
　ちゅうらしいんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I heard from her classmates that she left early because of
a headache, and that it's a relatively common occurence for
her."
dialogues.text:
"I heard from her classmates that she left early because of
a headache, and that it's a relatively common occurence for
her."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ふむ……でも、どうしてそれを俺に？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm... but why tell that to me?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm... but why tell that to me?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「共通する友人が早退したんだ、知らせておい
　た方がいいかなって思ってね」
dialogues.en:
"I thought you might want to know. You're her friend after
all."
dialogues.text:
"I thought you might want to know. You're her friend after
all."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「心配だよ」
dialogues.en: "It's a bit worrying."
dialogues.text: "It's a bit worrying."

dialogues.jp:
そう言う工藤の横顔には、確かに心配の色が強
く｛にじ／滲｝んでいた。
dialogues.en:
Now that I looked at it, Kudou's face did have more than a
touch of concern on it.
dialogues.text:
Now that I looked at it, Kudou's face did have more than a
touch of concern on it.

dialogues.jp:
俺は工藤から視線を離して、中庭をぼんやり眺
めた。
dialogues.en:
I remove my gaze from Kudou and looked around the courtyard
absent-mindedly.
dialogues.text:
I remove my gaze from Kudou and looked around the courtyard
absent-mindedly.

dialogues.jp:
頭が痛くても、それでも笑顔を絶やさないこと
りが何となく想像できた。
dialogues.en:
Even while she's having a headache, I bet Kotori would still
be giving everyone around her a ready smile.
dialogues.text:
Even while she's having a headache, I bet Kotori would still
be giving everyone around her a ready smile.

dialogues.jp:
かなり無理してるっていうか、笑顔も多少は引
きつってるんだろうけど。
dialogues.en:
That no matter her condition, she wants to show everyone
that she's fine and well.
dialogues.text:
That no matter her condition, she wants to show everyone
that she's fine and well.

dialogues.jp:
そう言うところが、学園のアイドルって言われ
る理由なのかもなぁ。
dialogues.en: It's for things like that that she's become the school idol.
dialogues.text: It's for things like that that she's become the school idol.

dialogues.jp: アイドルはいついかなる時も笑みを絶やさない。
dialogues.en:
An idol, one who, no matter the situation, always keeps on
smiling.
dialogues.text:
An idol, one who, no matter the situation, always keeps on
smiling.

dialogues.jp: ……違うか。
dialogues.en: ...It shouldn't be that way.
dialogues.text: ...It shouldn't be that way.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「それが決して少なくないから、一部ではサボ
　リではないかという噂も出てるんだが……」
dialogues.en: "It can at least be deduced from the talk around."
dialogues.text: "It can at least be deduced from the talk around."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「実際、本当に調子が悪いらしいな」
dialogues.en: "That Kotori's constitution isn't very good."
dialogues.text: "That Kotori's constitution isn't very good."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、体調が悪くなるのは誰にでもあること
　さ」
dialogues.en: "Well, there's a lot of people like that.
dialogues.text: "Well, there's a lot of people like that.

dialogues.jp: 特に我が家には病弱な妹がいるので、そう思う。
dialogues.en:
There's one in my family as well who often gets sick, after
all.
dialogues.text:
There's one in my family as well who often gets sick, after
all.

dialogues.jp:
自分でもどうにも出来ない体調の悪さって言う
のは、本人が一番堪えるんだよな……。
dialogues.en:
No matter what we say about how these people shouldn't
extend themselves, it's them who have to bear the weight of
their problems...
dialogues.text:
No matter what we say about how these people shouldn't
extend themselves, it's them who have to bear the weight of
their problems...

dialogues.jp: 俺は背もたれに背中を預けた。
dialogues.en: I thought this as I hunched over slightly.
dialogues.text: I thought this as I hunched over slightly.

dialogues.jp: まぐまぐと、パンを消費する。
dialogues.en: Bit by bit, I continued consuming my bread.
dialogues.text: Bit by bit, I continued consuming my bread.

dialogues.jp:
ことり……明日には、元気になっているといい
けどな。
dialogues.en: Kotori... hope you feel better tomorrow.
dialogues.text: Kotori... hope you feel better tomorrow.

dialogues.jp: そんなことをぼんやりと思った。
dialogues.en: That thought unconciously entered my head.
dialogues.text: That thought unconciously entered my head.

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりの早退◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kotori, on Early Leave Again◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kotori, on Early Leave Again◆

dialogues.jp:
中庭に居ると、杉並と工藤がやってきて、こと
りが早退したことを告げる。
dialogues.en:
In the courtyard, Suginami and Kudou dropped by to tell me
that Kotori had left school early today.
dialogues.text:
In the courtyard, Suginami and Kudou dropped by to tell me
that Kotori had left school early today.

dialogues.jp: ことり……明日は元気になっているといいけど。
dialogues.en: Kotori... hope you feel better tomorrow.
dialogues.text: Kotori... hope you feel better tomorrow.
